description: Generates one envelope stage, with a CV input for each knob, a choice of J or S curves, and a button beside each control jack

params.text: Forces the ACTIVE output to 10V while pressed
Sets the curvature of the stage; centred is a straight line, clockwise pushes the steep part towards the end and counter-clockwise towards the start, and the extremes are nearly square
Holds the DEFER signal at 10V while pressed, so the IN signal passes straight to OUT
Sets how long the stage takes, within the range chosen by the 1/10/100 switch
Sets the range of the DURATION knob: 1ms to 1 second, 10ms to 10 seconds, or 100ms to 100 seconds, with the knob centred giving a tenth of the maximum
Forces the EOC output to 10V while pressed
Sets the voltage at which the generated stage ends, within the range chosen by the UNI/BI switch
Sets the range of the LEVEL knob: 0-10V at UNI, or -5 to 5V at BI
Chooses the shape of the stage: a J curve that steepens at one end, or an S curve that steepens through the middle
Holds the TRIG signal at 10V while pressed, which starts a stage

inputs.text: Modulates the curvature; every 1V here turns the CURVE knob a tenth of its travel clockwise
While this gate is high the IN signal passes straight to OUT and any stage in progress is abandoned; it reads high above 1V
Modulates the duration; every 1V here turns the DURATION knob a tenth of its travel clockwise
Modulates the level; every 1V here turns the LEVEL knob a tenth of its travel clockwise
The voltage a stage starts from, sampled when the trigger arrives, and passed straight to OUT while DEFER is high
A rising edge starts a stage from the voltage at IN; a rise during a stage abandons it and starts a new one, and rises are ignored while DEFER is high; it reads high above 1V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while a stage is being generated or while DEFER is high, and 0V otherwise
Carries a 1ms 10V pulse when a stage completes
Carries the generated stage, the IN voltage while DEFER is high, or the LEVEL voltage after a stage has completed

notes: a knob turned while a stage runs takes effect at once, and the new value applies to the remainder of that stage
a stage runs only on a rising edge at the TRIG input or a press of the TRIG button; until the first one arrives OUT passes the IN voltage straight through, which is 0V with nothing patched
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
